segments.mil5.5.1:3.1: “Puna ca bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ ‘vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsayettha bahussute’ti.
segments.mil5.5.1:3.3: Yadi, bhante nāgasena, tathāgatena bhaṇitaṃ ‘santhavato bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyate rajo.
segments.mil5.5.1:3.5: Aniketamasanthavaṃ, etaṃ ve munidassanan’ti, tena hi ‘vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsayettha bahussute’ti yaṃ vacanaṃ, taṃ micchā.
segments.mil5.5.1:3.6: Yadi tathāgatena bhaṇitaṃ ‘vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsayettha bahussute’ti, tena hi ‘santhavato bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyate rajo.
segments.mil5.5.1:3.8: Aniketamasanthavaṃ, etaṃ ve munidassanan’ti tampi vacanaṃ micchā.
segments.mil5.5.1:3.9: Ayampi ubhato koṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo”ti.
segments.mil5.5.1:4.1: “Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā ‘santhavato bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyate rajo.
segments.mil5.5.1:4.6: Yaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ ‘santhavato bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyate rajo.
segments.mil5.5.1:4.8: Aniketamasanthavaṃ, etaṃ ve munidassanan’ti, taṃ sabhāvavacanaṃ asesavacanaṃ nissesavacanaṃ nippariyāyavacanaṃ samaṇānucchavaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ samaṇappatirūpaṃ samaṇārahaṃ samaṇagocaraṃ samaṇappaṭipadā samaṇappaṭipatti.
segments.mil5.5.1:4.9: Yathā, mahārāja, āraññako migo araññe pavane caramāno nirālayo aniketo yathicchakaṃ sayati, evameva kho, mahārāja, bhikkhunā ‘santhavato bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyate rajo.
segments.mil5.5.1:5.1: “Yaṃ pana, mahārāja, bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ ‘vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsayettha bahussute’ti, taṃ dve atthavase sampassamānena bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ.
segments.mil5.5.1:5.4: Vihāradānaṃ nāma sabbabuddhehi vaṇṇitaṃ anumataṃ thomitaṃ pasatthaṃ, taṃ te vihāradānaṃ datvā jātijarāmaraṇā parimuccissantīti.
segments.mil5.5.1:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ vihāre vijjamāne bhikkhuniyo byattasaṅketā bhavissanti, sulabhaṃ dassanaṃ dassanakāmānaṃ, anikete duddassanā bhavissantīti.
segments.mil5.5.1:6.3: Ime dve atthavase sampassamānena bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ ‘vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsayettha bahussute’ti, na tattha buddhaputtena ālayo karaṇīyo nikete”ti.
